IMMEDIATE OPENINGS




Role: Senior AI (Generative AI)

Experience: 15+ Years

Location: Bangalore & Mumbai

Work Mode: Hybrid

Shift: 2nd (2pm to 11pm)




Job Description Senior AI (Generative AI)




Role Summary: We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior AI Architect to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale AI and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in enterprise application architecture, AI solution design, client consulting, and technical leadership, with a proven track record of delivering production-grade AI platforms.

The role requires deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI governance, enterprise integrations, cloud-native architectures, and AI solution delivery. The candidate will work closely with customers, business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to define AI roadmaps and build scalable, secure, and high-performing AI solutions.




Key Responsibilities




AI Strategy & Architecture

Define the overall AI and Generative AI architecture for enterprise-scale solutions.
Design scalable, secure, and production-ready AI platforms leveraging modern AI technologies.
Define AI solution roadmaps, reference architectures, reusable frameworks, and best practices.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption strategies.

Solution Design & Delivery

Architect AI solutions using LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and Multi-Agent frameworks.
Design enterprise AI workflows involving reasoning engines, AI agents, prompt orchestration, and workflow automation.
Design scalable data ingestion, vectorization, indexing, grounding, and retrieval architectures.
Lead architecture reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards.
Guide engineering teams during implementation and deployment.

AI Engineering

Design and implement enterprise AI applications using GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Mistral, and other foundation models.
Architect multi-model AI solutions with model routing and Mixture of Experts (MoE).
Design AI observability, evaluation, prompt management, caching, and optimization strategies.
Drive AI model tuning, grounding improvements, hallucination reduction, and response optimization.

Cloud & Platform Architecture

Design cloud-native AI platforms on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Architect scalable APIs, microservices, serverless applications, and event-driven AI solutions.
Design secure deployment architectures using Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
Define monitoring, logging, security, governance, and compliance standards.

Customer Engagement & Leadership

Engage with customers to understand business problems and translate them into AI solutions.
Lead solution workshops, architecture discussions, technical reviews, and executive presentations.
Support pre-sales activities including solution proposals, estimations, SOW preparation, and technical presentations.
Mentor architects, technical leads, and engineering teams on AI technologies and best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, DevOps, Data Engineering, Security, and Business stakeholders.

Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
15+ years of experience in enterprise software development and architecture.
Minimum 5+ years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solution architecture.
Proven experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions into Production.

Deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs).
Hands-on experience with GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Mistral, or similar foundation models.
